zoom.notes: MATERIAL REAL-IMPORT DISCREPANCY. The orbit-to-zoom boundary at frame 1770 is structurally continuous, and Earth Studio imports the planned numeric terminal state (12,000 km, longitude 2.352, latitude 48.857, pan -2x 0 degrees, tilt 35 degrees). However, the 9:16 Camera view loses the Earth during the zoom: a small limb remains at frame 1852 (2,368 km, tilt 55.999 degrees), the view is fully black by frame 1856 (2,584 km, tilt 55.591 degrees), and it stays black through frames 2060-2130. This contradicts the checklist expectation of a usable space-scale globe view.

tilt.notes: Earth Studio preserved the authored tilt values, but the authored 60-to-35-degree space-zoom tilt/rotation composition points the vertical Camera view away from Earth before the zoom completes. This is planner/composition ownership, not import reinterpretation.
